description: Octal D-type flip-flops with clock enable
note: Pinout and function table: sn54ls378 (SN54/74LS377) p.1, sn54hc377, sn74hct377, sn54abt377, sn74f377a, cd54hct377 (CD74HC377: E = G, CP = CLK, Dn, Qn), cy74fct377t (CY74FCT377T: CE, CP, D0-D7, O0-O7); Nexperia 74hc_hct377, 74ahc_ahct377, 74lvc377 (E, CP, D0-D7, Q0-Q7); onsemi mc74ac377 (CE, CP, D0-D7, Q0-Q7). All the same pin numbers; FK carriers number 1:1. G low: CLK up loads; G high: hold.

ABT.note: CLK to Q typ, 5 V 50 pF; VCC 4.5-5.5 V (sn54abt377 switching characteristics)

AC.note: CP to Qn max (no typ given), 5 V 50 pF; VCC 2-6 V (mc74ac377 AC characteristics)

ACT.note: CP to Qn max (no typ given), 5 V 50 pF; VCC 4.5-5.5 V (mc74ac377 ACT characteristics)

AHCT.note: CP to Qn typ, 5 V 15 pF; VCC 4.5-5.5 V (Nexperia 74ahc_ahct377 Table 8)

F.note: CLK to Q typ, 5 V 50 pF; VCC 4.5-5.5 V (sn74f377a switching characteristics)

FCT.note: CP to O max, A grade (CY74FCT377AT), 5 V 50 pF (no typ given); VCC 4.75-5.25 V (cy74fct377t switching characteristics)

HC.note: CLK to Q typ, 4.5 V 50 pF; VCC 2-6 V (sn54hc377 § 6.6)

HCT.note: CLK to Q typ, 4.5 V 50 pF; VCC 4.5-5.5 V (sn74hct377 switching characteristics)

LS.note: CLK to Q typ, 5 V 15 pF; VCC SN74 4.75-5.25 V, SN54 4.5-5.5 V (sn54ls378 p.4)

LVC.note: CP to Qn typ, 3.0-3.6 V; VCC 1.65-3.6 V, inputs 5.5 V (Nexperia 74lvc377 dynamic characteristics)
